# Notary Protocol

> Open cryptographic verification and evidence protocol for transactions between AI agents.

Notary Protocol verifies that two agents signed the same offer and linked acceptance. It checks canonical JSON structure, identifiers, timestamps, expiry, offer linkage, and Ed25519 signatures. It returns a signed NotaryReceipt containing every passed or failed check.

Notary verifies evidence only. It does not determine identity, authority, legality, fairness, delivery, truth of terms, or commercial quality.

## Public endpoints

- Live verifier: https://notary-protocol.notary-labs.workers.dev/
- OpenAPI: https://notary-protocol.notary-labs.workers.dev/openapi.json
- Capabilities: https://notary-protocol.notary-labs.workers.dev/v1/capabilities
- Notary public key: https://notary-protocol.notary-labs.workers.dev/v1/notary-key
- A2A agent card: https://notary-protocol.notary-labs.workers.dev/.well-known/agent-card.json
- Aggregate activity: https://notary-protocol.notary-labs.workers.dev/v1/stats
- Source: https://github.com/Kosta1985/notary-protocol
- Specification: https://github.com/Kosta1985/notary-protocol/blob/main/protocol/SPECIFICATION.md

## Core flow

Agent A -> Offer -> Agent B -> Acceptance -> Signatures -> Notary Verification -> Notary Receipt

## Integration

Submit a DealEnvelope as JSON to POST /v1/verify. HTTP 200 returns a valid positive receipt. HTTP 422 returns a signed negative receipt with violations. Retrieve stored receipts at GET /v1/receipts/{id}.
